gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Revalia strides across the line with widely separated letters and a g whose lower curve stays open. And Noto Sans Tamil, which looks magnified without growing, lets its terminals stop well away from the stem, so paragraphs feel spacious.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supple: Noto Sans Tamil Supplement sets round forms that read like open parentheses beneath a bold Revalia heading. But its middle band is so deep that lines look stocky, and a long passage comes across sturdy and clean.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Noto Sans Tangsa greets Revalia with a wide, inviting opening on its round letters. Its short ascender stems keep the body approachable, while Revalia's expressive g and relaxed stride carry the loudest voice in the pair.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Expressive Revalia leads with a loose, open-tailed g. Noto Sans Thai Looped follows with bold-looking lowercase and spacious gaps at its curve terminals, so the display heading and the body feel like one conversation.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Clean, rounded Noto Sans Tifinagh keeps its letters open and inviting, with lowercase bowls puffed up like inflated shapes. Revalia handles the shouting; this plain sans handles the reading.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Revalia's open-tailed g and relaxed stride across widely spaced letters make the heading unmistakable. Noto Sans Ugaritic then tucks the x-height almost up to the cap height, so the plain sans body sits snugly under the loose display lines.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Contemporary and clean, Noto Sans Warang Citi forms words that read as solid blocks rather than skylines. And with wide channels leading into each counter, a long passage under Revalia's bold heading moves along smoothly.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-sq: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square soars with a high x-height and wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp. And beneath bold Revalia, a longer passage would feel approachable and contemporary, never cramped.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-prompt: Approachable Prompt gives its small letters an oversized look and keeps its apertures open for easy reading. And under Revalia's bold, expressive heading, a longer passage would feel friendly and unhurried.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-questrial: Revalia's open-curled g and relaxed, widely spaced stride mark it out at once. But Questrial brings a flat, stencil-cut feel from single-weight strokes, and that crisp, modern restraint is what makes the pair stand apart.
